analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus remains Buy across 18-25 covering analysts (22 Buy / 3 Hold / 1 Sell); 12-month avg PT $327.44 (high $394, low $155). No specific upgrade/downgrade actions surfaced in the last 7 days.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 beat: net sales $2.65B (+30% YoY), adj operating margin 20.8%, raised full-year guidance citing AI data center demand. Already priced-in driver of the recent ~28% one-month rally. Near-term headwinds flagged: EMEA revenue decline, APAC timing, tariff/supply chain pressure.
